rules.pattern: ^#? *(阅读与思考|探究与发现|信息技术应用|文献阅读与数学写作)\s+(.+?)(?:\s*[.．…·]+\s*\d+)?$
^#? *(小结|复习参考题\s*\d*|部分中英文词汇索引)(?:\s*[.．…·]+\s*\d+)?$
^(\#{1,3})\s+(?!(?:目录|第[一二三四五六七八九十]+章\s|(?:\d+\.\d+\*?\s+)|阅读与思考\s|探究与发现\s|信息技术应用\s|文献阅读与数学写作\s|小结(?:$|\s)|复习参考题\s*\d*|部分中英文词汇索引))(.+)$

notes: Rules standardize headings from TOC: '目录' to H1, chapter (第...章) to H1, numbered sections (e.g., 4.1) to H2, special subsections (阅读与思考, etc.) to H3, back matter (小结, 复习参考题, etc.) to H2.
All TOC headings have page numbers and leader dots removed during standardization.
Remaining headings (e.g., '思考', '归纳') are demoted to H4 using negative lookahead to avoid clashes with TOC heading levels.
